source.description: Resurvey (LP-numbered) village exports kept in this folder. These are a newer, finer edition than the 2021 Prakasam archive for the same eight villages (Chinthagunta: 2,100 plots here against 276), so a build that includes both lists this source first and it wins at a shared address.

districtRule: Placed by DISTRICT_CODE-MANDAL_CODE from services/api/data/mandals.csv, confirmed by each village's outline falling inside the same-named village of the 2021 archive.
